name: voice.piper
title: Voice (Piper TTS)
summary: Synthesize voice-over lines to 16-bit mono WAV files with a local Piper voice, one file per line, with per-line durations and speech-end times.
description: Speaks each line in `lines` with a Piper voice and writes <name or line-001>.wav into the job's output folder. Every take is different (Piper's VITS sampling), so results are never cached. `speech_end_s` is where the audible speech stops inside the file: useful for snapping cuts without trimming a natural tail. Pass raw IPA inside [[ ... ]] when a name must be pronounced exactly, and raise `length_scale` slightly (about 1.1) for gravitas.

voice.description: Voice name as installed in the voice folders, e.g. en_US-norman-medium. Either voice or voice_file is required.

voice_file.description: A specific .onnx voice file (workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>) with its .onnx.json config beside it. Use instead of voice to pin an exact model.

lines.description: The lines to speak, in order; each one becomes its own WAV file.

text.description: What to say. Text inside [[ ... ]] is passed to Piper as raw IPA phonemes, for example "My name is [[ʃˈɒpˌuːə.]]"; the final punctuation must sit INSIDE the brackets, otherwise the model keeps the raw phonemes going through the next sentence.

name.description: Output file name without .wav, e.g. who-0 writes who-0.wav. Omit to get line-001, line-002, ... Names must be unique inside one call.

length_scale.description: Speaking rate control: above 1 is slower (about 1.1 for gravitas), below 1 is faster. Omit to use the voice's own setting (1.0).

noise_scale.description: Generator noise; higher is more varied and expressive, lower is flatter. Omit to use the voice's own setting.

noise_w_scale.description: Phoneme-width noise, i.e. timing variation; lower is more metronomic. Omit to use the voice's own setting.

speaker.description: Speaker id for a multi-speaker voice. Omit for the voice's default speaker.

volume.description: Gain multiplier applied to every line (1 = unchanged, 0.5 = quieter, 2 = louder). Applied after normalisation, and the result is clipped to full scale.

normalize_audio.description: Scale each line so its loudest sample reaches full scale (Piper's per-sentence normalisation). false keeps the model's raw levels, which vary per line.

speech_end_threshold_db.description: Level (dBFS) below which a sample counts as silence when finding speech_end_s. Lower it for quiet voices, raise it to cut more tail.
